data.title: Fine for running a red light – €118.50
data.summary: The district office's fines office (Bußgeldstelle) issued a fine notice for running a red light on 31 August 2026. The total is €118.50 (fine €90 plus fees) and 1 point in the driving aptitude register.
data.explanation: You are accused of driving through a red light in Musterrode. You must pay €118.50 and get 1 point in the Flensburg register (Fahreignungsregister). You may object (Einspruch) in writing or by recording it at the office; the app shows the deadline, counted from the delivery date stamped on the envelope. The office must receive it in time. If you do not object, the decision becomes final (rechtskräftig) and you then have two weeks to pay. Consider legal advice if you want to contest it.

items.title: Object to the fine notice (Einspruch)

date.text: innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach seiner Zustellung

items.quote: Einspruch gegen diesen Bußgeldbescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach seiner Zustellung einlegen.
items.action: If you disagree, file a written objection or one recorded at the office, so that it arrives by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: The decision becomes final and the fine can be enforced.
